evidenceLibrary.excerpt: Cambridge Beaches Resort & Spa appeared in a monitored AI answer for a quiet cottage-colony / romantic Bermuda stay.
evidenceLibrary.whyThisMatters: Shows a monitored case where the property is included for a relevant leisure or romantic traveler need.
evidenceLibrary.managementReview: Protect the public signals that support this strength, including private beaches, cottages, oceanfront setting, and romantic positioning.

evidenceLibrary.excerpt: Rosewood Bermuda appeared in a monitored executive retreat scenario where Cambridge Beaches Resort & Spa was absent.
evidenceLibrary.whyThisMatters: Shows a monitored case where a competitor was surfaced for a demand segment where Cambridge Beaches may want stronger visibility. This does not prove causation.
evidenceLibrary.managementReview: Review whether meeting space, group packages, retreat positioning, privacy, and event capabilities are clearly represented across public sources.

evidenceLibrary.excerpt: All-Inclusive Option was recognized in only 7.0% of applicable monitored answers.
evidenceLibrary.whyThisMatters: This attribute is part of the monitored property proposition but is infrequently reflected in AI answers. This should be reviewed.
evidenceLibrary.managementReview: Verify whether the all-inclusive offer is accurately and consistently described on the hotel website and major booking/travel platforms.

evidenceLibrary.excerpt: TripAdvisor appeared in 84.4% of cited sources in the current monitoring period.
evidenceLibrary.whyThisMatters: Review platforms may be important public evidence sources for AI-generated hotel answers. This may indicate an area for reputation and response review.
evidenceLibrary.managementReview: Review recurring themes, response quality, and factual misconceptions that may affect how the hotel is interpreted.

bottomLineSummary: Cambridge Beaches Resort & Spa is visible in AI answers, especially for leisure and romantic travel. The risk is not broad invisibility. The risk is selective demand leakage: AI recognizes the hotel for many traveler needs, but competitors appear when the hotel is absent in certain business, meeting, or group scenarios.
bottomLinePriority: If Meetings & Groups matters commercially to the hotel, this finding may warrant further review.

inferredDemandLeak.title: Demand Area to Review
inferredDemandLeak.summary: Based on the monitored sample, Meetings & Groups appears to be the primary demand area to review. Rosewood Bermuda appeared in 3 monitored scenarios where Cambridge Beaches Resort & Spa was absent. This does not prove lost bookings or causation, but it does identify a visible AI displacement pattern.

whyThisMayMatterCommercially.title: Why This May Matter Commercially
whyThisMayMatterCommercially.body: This finding does not assume Meetings & Groups is the hotel’s commercial priority. It indicates that if the hotel wants to grow meetings, retreats, corporate groups, or private events, AI may not be consistently connecting the property to that demand.
whyThisMayMatterCommercially.bridge: The paid ADP pilot would confirm the hotel’s priorities and monitor the demand areas that matter most to the owner/operator.

likelyReason: The evidence suggests Cambridge Beaches may have weaker or less consistent public signals for meetings, retreats, and certain business-use cases. This does not prove causation.
thirdFix: Stand up TripAdvisor theme and response tracking

executiveSummary.title: Executive Summary
paragraphs: Cambridge Beaches Resort & Spa shows strong overall AI visibility in the monitored sample, with AI Consideration of 71.3% and Scenario Presence of 95.0%. The clearest strength is leisure and romantic travel, where the hotel shows a visibility advantage versus comparable hotels.
The primary demand area to review is Meetings & Groups. In those monitored scenarios, other hotels appear more often while Cambridge Beaches is missing or weakly associated.
Reality Coverage gaps suggest AI answers do not consistently reflect the hotel’s full product attributes. Dealality should help prepare source and content improvements before any paid ADP pilot.
This limited diagnostic does not prove causation. It identifies where demand may be leaking in AI answers so the commercial team can decide what to review first.
